programs.title: Scared Shrekless
programs.desc: Halloween is coming.This year, Shrek's favorite holiday is going to be really scary.Instead of traditional fun, refreshments and tricks, the ogre challenges his friends.Together with Fiona, Donkey, Puss in Boots and other fairy tale characters, he plans to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle.The atmosphere of horror is to be fueled by spine-chilling stories.The one who overcomes his fear will win the competition.Biscuits, Donkey, Puss in Boots and Shrek tell dark stories... In the Polish version, the characters are voiced by famous actors, including:Zbigniew Zamachowski (Shrek) and Jerzy Stuhr (Donkey).

programs.title: Eine Million Minuten
programs.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programs.title: Amrum
programs.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
programs.desc: Harry Potter spends the summer with the Dursleys in London.In the Muggle neighborhood, he and his cousin Dudley are attacked by Dementors.Soon, members of the Order of the Phoenix escort him to their organization's headquarters.Harry learns that the association was established to fight Voldemort.After the holidays, Potter returns to Hogwarts to begin his fifth year of study.A rumor begins to circulate about him that he lied and never actually met Voldemort.This time, Defense Against the Dark Arts is taught at Dolores Umbridge's school.As it turns out, the woman does not intend to practically prepare students to fight dark forces, because she believes that there is no need.Soon the teacher takes over the office of the school's grand inquisitor.Harry, sensing the approaching danger, shares his fears with Ron and Hermione.He secretly begins teaching selected colleagues Defense Against the Dark Arts.It soon turns out that he was right.

programs.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programs.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programs.title: E Poi Si Vede
programs.desc: Three friends compete for an attractive job at the city hall.Federico relies on his father's connections, Fabrizio feels that he is born for this job, and Luca is always lucky.
